facts.text: Business is business, Mr. Bond. The vodka is on me, but the information will cost you.
facts.why: The quote page has Zukovsky's real line about the Walther PPK and nothing like this. The printed words are an invented quote, though as a note it suits a man who sells information.
facts.fix: Use a note: The vodka is on me, Mr. Bond. The information will cost you.

fix_note.text: The vodka is on me, Mr. Bond. The information will cost you.

facts.why: Sources opened do not name or describe Zukovsky's St Petersburg place. The Monte Carlo casino is a separate scene.
No source opened gives a name for his club, so 'Valentin's' is not confirmed.

vibe.verdict: A smoky club frame with the VIP 006 card and a good Russian menu, missing the film's famous gadgets and lines.
missing: Bond's vodka martini, shaken not stirred (the casino)
